newsitem.title: USA: Sonic to add 130 restaurants in fiscal '97.
newsitem.headline: Sonic to add 130 restaurants in fiscal '97.

text.p: Sonic Corp, which franchises and operates 1,587 drive-in restaurants in 27 states, said Monday it plans to add 130 restaurants in fiscal 1997.

During its fiscal 1997 first quarter ended November 30, 1996, Sonic opened nine new company-owned restaurants and 20 franchised drive-ins. A total of six company-owned and three franchised restaurants closed during the first quarter.
During its first fiscal quarter, Sonic reported that same-store sales rose 1.4 percent for company-owned restaurants and 4.4 percent on a systemwide basis.
Sonic also noted that total systemwide sales for the calendar year ended December 31, 1996, surpassed $1.0 billion for the first time in the company's history.

Sonic reported earnings for its fiscal first quarter rose to $4.4 million or $0.32 a share from $3.5 million or $0.27 in the same quarter a year earlier. Revenues rose to almost $41 million from $34.1 million in the fiscal 1996 first quarter.

"We continue to see substantial benefits from our brand- building efforts, as seen in the company's top- and bottom-line growth for the quarter," said J. Clifford Hudson, president and chief executive officer, in a statement.
